IMGS-221.name: Vision & Psychophysics
IMGS-221.description: Introduces the human visual system and psychophysical techniques for studying perception.

IMGS-261.description: Develops complex numbers, linear algebra and discrete and continuous Fourier transforms for frequency-domain imaging models.
